title: A Horizon for the Machine
author: Xanthe Lockridge
blurb: Lena Yarrow, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
